content.title: Japan's Takeda weighs India for global trials to speed up drug launches
content.summary: (Reuters) -Japanese drugmaker Takeda Pharmaceutical is exploring the option of conducting global clinical trials in India to accelerate the launch of its innovative drugs in the world's most populous nation, its India head told Reuters.  The plan comes at a time when India's clinical trials market is growing, powered by diverse patient pools, cost efficiency, and a fast-growing hospital network.  Grand View Research expects the market to exceed $2 billion by 2030.
